mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we are looking at 65 degrees under overcast skies near Reddan Soccer Park, with a full moon rising tonight.

The City of Verona continues its partnership with AECOM for engineering services, and the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is seeking public input on the US 18/151 Corridor study with meetings scheduled for November 18 and 19.

We have plenty to look forward to, including trivia today at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus activities like yoga and live music tomorrow, and the annual Main Street Trick or Treat this Thursday.
On October 25, officers arrested a man for an O W I offence after finding him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist. The store is open and serving until 10 PM tonight, so stop in for a scoop.
